description: Astral Stories, tales echoing across new adventures.
summary: Machines That Stayed Behind is a digital storybook that explores the stories of NASA's discarded spacecraft and equipment on the Moon and Mars. We developed this project to bring attention to forgotten space explorers by transforming their missions, purposes, achievements and discoveries into engaging stories. Through simple language, illustrations and an attractive digital format, our project makes space exploration easier to understand, especially for children aged 9-12. It addresses the challenge by highlighting the historical and scientific importance of equipment left behind after space missions. The project aims to increase awareness of NASA's exploration history, encourage curiosity about space science and inspire future generations. It is important because even though these machines may no longer be active, their contributions to humanity's understanding of other worlds should never be forgotten.
details: Our project, “Machines That stayed Behind” is a digital storybook that brings some of the stories of NASA's discarded spacecraft and equipment on the Moon and Mars to life. It explores their purposes, missions, achievements, discoveries and the reasons they were left behind. The project is designed to make space exploration interesting and understandable, especially for children aged 9-12, through simple language, illustrations and engaging storytelling. It provides educational benefits by increasing awareness of space science, preserving the history of past missions and inspiring curiosity about the universe. Our aim is to help people understand that even when a space mission ends, its contributions to science should never be forgotten. We use Canva to design the digital storybook and NASA's official websites as sources of reliable information, along with digital images and illustrations to make the content attractive. The creativity of our project lies in presenting abandoned equipment not merely as objects left in space, but as forgotten explorers with unique stories to tell. While developing it, we considered scientific accuracy, accessibility, age suitability, visual design, simplicity and educational value to ensure that the storybook is informative, engaging and meaningful.
